decision.rationale: Patrick selected option A: ship it. No additional rationale supplied.

selected_mutation.title: Revelation Threshold, Then Live Bargain
selected_mutation.structural_change: Remove contract formation and resolution from Act 1. Each route ends with a truth the player forced the Voyd to reveal and a threshold election between withdrawing with that truth or entering Act 2 to seek a concrete change. Withdrawal creates an unbound_closed handoff with no contract semantics. Continuing creates a petition_pending handoff carrying the disclosed truth, its constraint on future terms, and initiative. Act 2 then runs a deterministic pre-contract state machine: capture and validate a petition, expose its counterforce, offer terms, and present explicit acceptance or refusal actions. Contract identity and leverage cannot exist before that sequence completes.
selected_mutation.story_consequence: Act 1 becomes a complete contest for truth and access rather than a compressed bargain ledger. Act 2 gains an opening scene whose dramatic work is the creation and opposition of a concrete objective. Players who withdraw have a genuinely different continuation governed by knowledge and initiative, while players who continue enter a bargain they actively construct instead of being told that an unspecified contract brought them there.
cost: Replaces the current Act 1 contract return, test, and payoff machinery with revelation and threshold branches.
Requires a new non-contract handoff schema and deterministic Act 2 lifecycle processing in both browser and headless runtimes.
Requires the story packet builder to traverse beyond the Act 1 boundary so the bargain lifecycle can be reviewed model-free.
Changes existing tests that assume every route reaches Act 2 with an identified, resolved contract.
Lengthens the experience by separating revelation, petition, counterforce, offer, and resolution into causally distinct exchanges.

eliminated.basis: Interactive Drama Adversary demonstrated that petition_declined has no defined terminating consequence, renewed action, or structurally separate continuation, so the choice can be erased at the Act 2 frontier or become a dead end.
